title: TranscriptionSync: training-free lip synchronization for native-audio LLMs — code and evaluation scripts
description: TranscriptionSync drives 14 ARKit mouth blendshapes from the output of native-audio (speech-to-speech) large language models without training. The repository contains the streaming viseme engine (Python package transcription-sync), the evaluation modules (paper/tools) and all scripts of the revised evaluation (paper/revision): wall-clock Layer-1 latency, streaming CTC alignment of the Live API transcription, video-measured GRID evaluation including an Audio2Face-3D port, re-trained audio-to-blendshape regressors, SyncNet offset tests and a re-collected Gemini Live evaluation (English and Turkish). No datasets, model weights or API keys are included.
